pos.personaBrief: River 2014-2022 is described as offensive and possession-dominant, with positional attacks (36 per match) and few counters; he said a team must have the ball and prefers this idea over counterattacking.

pro.personaBrief: Short, precise passes from defence and gradual build through the thirds, with changes of pace to launch attacks and quick recoveries; not long-ball.

est.personaBrief: He stresses flexible systems and freedom for players, with changing shapes (4-4-2, 4-1-3-2, 4-3-3) and a 4-2-2-2 'extremely flexible'; relational leaning with rondo-like closeness.

lar.personaBrief: Fullbacks project continuously to give width while the 4-3-1-2/4-2-2-2 shapes concentrate creators centrally, so both routes are used with fullbacks as the wide source.

blo.personaBrief: High pressing is a hallmark (2016 4-2-2-2, 2014 pressing drills, counter-pressing in 2018), recovering the ball near the rival box with 7-9 players in the opponent half.

mar.personaBrief: Open-play marking is undocumented; the team protects central areas with numbers and defends spaces, so zonal leaning, with no evidence of dedicated man-marking.

pla.personaBrief: He keeps playing his way even when it costs ('no vamos a cambiar las formas', preferring risk over counterattacking), but adapts system to the players and moments.

res.personaBrief: He prefers proactive, risky football even if results might be better otherwise, yet won 14 titles and plays to win; a back five in the 2018 final shows pragmatism when needed.

sis.personaBrief: Collective idea and duties for all (quick recovery runs, counter-pressing), but built around technical creators like D'Alessandro, Pity Martinez and Quintero.

jog.personaBrief: Prizes intelligence, passing and vision (Ignacio Fernandez profile, creators like Quintero), with high intensity in the press as a base.

bas.personaBrief: Debuted 35+ academy players and developed sellable talents, yet recruited 58 players and relied on experienced figures; titles are the main goal.

lid.personaBrief: Described as forming excellent groups and a people manager (neuroscience staff, rotation explained), while firmly in command, defying a ban to give the team talk.
